_status: PROVISIONAL SMOKE TEST - NOT A FINAL EVALUATION
_warning: These questions were written by the implementer against the ingested corpus.
Metrics from this set measure whether the retrieval pipeline is wired up and
behaving sanely. They are NOT an independent evaluation, because the same
person wrote the questions and tuned the thresholds - that is self-confirming.
P4's independent 40-question set must replace this file before any number
here is reported as an evaluation result.
_method: Questions were written from the source documents via the section map, not
from retrieval output, and were fixed before the pipeline was first run.
Labels are (document_id, section) pairs. Section-level labelling is used
rather than chunk-level because several adjacent chunks can legitimately
answer the same question; demanding one exact chunk would understate recall.
